title: Irish Beef Stew with a Japanese Twist
description: A hearty and flavorful stew combining the richness of irish beef with the bold flavors of japanese ingredients. Perfect for a cold winter night.

ingredients.name: irish
ingredients.notes: use a flavorful cut such as chuck or round

instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Add the speck and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the beef and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside.
Add more oil if necessary, then sauté the onion and garlic until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the carrots and potatoes, and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Add the soy sauce, sake, and beef broth, stirring to combine.
Return the beef to the pot and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 2 1/2 hours, or until the beef is tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped green onions.
